```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

source("functions/data_cleaning_functions.R")
```

```{r read csv}
sample_kills <- read.csv("./data/sample_kills_112874-112974.csv")
sample_rounds <- read.csv("./data/sample_rounds_112874-112974.csv")
```

```{r summary}
summary(sample_kills)
summary(sample_rounds)
```

```{r}
sample_rounds |> filter(is.na(purchase_cost_gap_ct)) |> select(file_id, map_name, round_num, winner, reason)
```

```{r number of maps}
sample_rounds |> select(file_name) |> unique() |> nrow()
```

Looking at the number of rounds per map
```{r}
sample_rounds |> 
  group_by(file_id, map_name, file_name) |> 
  summarise(num_rounds = max(round_num)) |> 
  arrange(desc(num_rounds)) |> print(n = 30)
```
This still does not entirely solve the problem. There is also the concept of overtime. We should ensure that all of these games are truly in overtime with a quick calculation.

```{r overtime}
overtime_games <- sample_rounds |> 
  group_by(file_name) |> 
  summarise(
    num_rounds = max(round_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(num_rounds > 24) |>
  arrange(desc(num_rounds)) |>
  select(file_name)

sample_rounds |>
  semi_join(overtime_games, by = "file_name") |> 
  filter(round_num <= 24) |>
  group_by(file_name) |>
  summarise(
    ct_team_1_wins = sum(winner[round_num <= 12] == "counter-terrorist", na.rm = TRUE),
    t_team_1_wins = sum(winner[round_num >= 13 & round_num <= 24] == "terrorist", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_wins = ct_team_1_wins + t_team_1_wins,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(total_wins)
```

Only *black-phoenix-vs-lph-m1-nuke.dem* is inaccurate. Looking into the game itself, it appears this is some explainable error. We will exclude this map in our study. We can also exclude all rounds after round 24 for now.

```{r}
sample_rounds_cleaned <- remove_overtime(sample_rounds)

sample_rounds_cleaned |> 
  group_by(file_id, map_name, file_name) |> 
  summarise(num_rounds = max(round_num)) |> 
  arrange(desc(num_rounds)) |> print(n = 30)
```

This should work for now. Let's look at the remaining *NA* values for economy.

```{r}
summary(sample_rounds_cleaned)

sample_rounds_cleaned |> filter(is.na(ct_equip))
```

The issues appear to only occur during pistol rounds (round 1 and 13.)

```{r}
sample_rounds_cleaned |> filter(file_name == "damajuan-vs-a-nata-m3-inferno.dem")
```


```{r combine}
data <- first_round_kill(sample_rounds, sample_kills)
```

```{r pistol round}
data <- is_pistol_round(data)
```

```{r relative econ gap}
data <- data |>
  mutate(rel_equip_gap_ct = log(ct_equip / t_equip))
```

```{r remove unnecessary columns}
data <- data |> select(-ct_team, -t_team)
```

```{r exploratory graph}
plot_data <- sample_rounds |>
    filter(round_num >= 1, round_num <= 12) |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(ct_equip, t_equip),
        names_to = "side",
        values_to = "cash"
    )

mean_data <- plot_data |>
    group_by(round_num, side) |>
    summarise(
        n = sum(!is.na(cash)),
        mean_cash = mean(cash, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cash = sd(cash, na.rm = TRUE),
        se = sd_cash / sqrt(n),
        t_critical = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
        lower = mean_cash - t_critical * se,
        upper = mean_cash + t_critical * se,
        .groups = "drop"
    )

ggplot() +
    geom_line(
        data = plot_data,
        aes(
            x = round_num, y = cash,
            color = side,
            group = interaction(file_id, map_name, side)
        ),
        alpha = 0.10,
        linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        data = mean_data,
        aes(
            x = round_num, ymin = lower, ymax = upper,
            color = side
        ),
        width = 0.15,
        linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_line(
        data = mean_data,
        aes(x = round_num, y = mean_cash, color = side),
        linewidth = 1.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = mean_data,
        aes(x = round_num, y = mean_cash, color = side),
        size = 2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
        values = c(ct_equip = "blue", t_equip = "red"),
        labels = c(ct_equip = "CT", t_equip = "T"),
        name = "Side"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(
        title = "Equipment Value Across the First 12 Rounds",
        subtitle = "Individual matches in faint lines; bold lines show means with 95% confidence intervals",
        x = "Round",
        y = "Mean Team Equipment Value ($)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top"
    )
```



```{r}
maps <- data |> select(file_name) |> unique()
train_size <- round(nrow(maps) * 0.6)

train_maps <- maps |>
  slice_sample(n = train_size)

test_maps <- maps |>
  anti_join(train_maps, by = "file_name")

train_data <- data |>
  semi_join(train_maps, by = "file_name")

test_data <- data |>
  semi_join(test_maps, by = "file_name")
```
